This paper uses bibliometric methods to analyze 25,871 publications on communication encryption from the Web of Science Core Collection between 1990 and 2024. The results show a continuous growth trend in research on communication encryption, with China being the academic leader in this field. However, there is still room for improvement in paper quality to enhance international influence. Keyword cluster analysis identifies five major research themes: authentication, blockchain, image encryption, quantum key distribution, and wireless communication. Quantum key distribution, as the future direction of communication security, has attracted significant attention.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enabled Secure IoT Module for Smart Agriculture in Diverse Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) stands as a revolutionary technology which impacts smart agriculture and different sectors beyond it. The research describes an intelligent IoT-enabled monitoring system which uses sensors to bring improved agricultural performance through environmental real-time observations combined with artificial intelligence decision systems. The proposed system completes its operation by executing sensor data acquisition followed by deep learning-based analysis and secure data transmission procedures. The initial stage of IoT-enabled operation utilizes environment-sensing devices which collect essential parameters for precision farming. A Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) processing system applies classification methods to collected data to generate useful insights. Secure cloud data transmission takes place through an encryption system which combines Substitution-Caesar cipher with Improved Elliptic Curve Cryptography (IECC). The system demonstrates 99.64% accuracy, and the proposed encryption method proves efficiency through its average execution times of encryption at 0.3904 ms and decryption at 0.1102 ms which exceeds current models in speed and security performance.

articleTitle: A Robust Unit Combination Model For Multi-Resource Backup Coordination Optimization Of Source, Network And Storage Is Considered
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to address the impact of the high proportion of new energy applications on the operation of traditional power grids and energy storage equipment, a robust unit combination model considering the multi-resource reserve coordination optimization of source-grid-load-storage is proposed. Firstly, the model to which the article belongs is based on the extraction of the characteristics of wind power generation prediction deviation from a time perspective. At the same time, quantile theory is applied to fit the numerical range of wind power generation prediction deviation based on the time perspective, which can better clarify the instability of wind power generation output. Secondly, considering the operational characteristics and reserve capabilities of various resources in the systems source-grid-load-storage, This article takes the daily running period as a case model and improves the robustness of the model through two stages, output, and reserve capacity coordination of all types of resources. This model employs nested column generation algorithms with constraints to solve the problem. Case studies have confirmed the effectiveness and advancement of this model in enhancing system operational flexibility and promoting the consumption of renewable energy, providing practical references and theoretical support for the determination of unit combination and reserve capacity schemes in new power systems under large scale consolidation of new energy.

articleTitle: Mental Stress Prediction Using Machine Learning and Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Stress and mental well-being have emerged as frontline investigation issues in health research. Chronic stress has been proven to affect people’s physical and mental well-being. This paper proposes an integrated model of ML models and CNN to predict stress from the detection of facial emotion. It is designed based on the capabilities of Random Forest and adaptive boosting to evaluate the real-time emotional states of the students, thus keeping in line with the intention of early identification of mental health issues. In particular, the project targets university students for categorizing their academic stress levels either as low, medium, or high through their behavioral and emotional data. This is a CNN model that takes facial expressions and produces emotion categories like happiness, sadness, anger, and surprise, and provides real-time insight to the stress levels. The most important features regarding stress levels are discussed at length, like GPA, social support, sleep patterns, and digital behaviors. The results suggest how ML and CNN-based emotion detection can monitor and improve student mental health by managing their stress levels by introducing intervention at an early stage, supportive environments, and personalized coping strategies.

articleTitle: AI Innovations in Heart Disease Prediction using Machine Learning and Risk Stratification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The goal of the heart disease prediction project is to use machine learning and deep learning techniques to create an accurate and efficient system. To obtain insights into the dataset, the project starts with thorough data preprocessing, which includes data cleansing, addressing missing values, and conducting exploratory data analysis. Data visualisation tools are used to support this research in order to find important patterns and correlations that help with the model-building stage. By combining several decision trees, the method increases the predictive potential of the model. To guarantee robustness and dependability, performance is assessed using important measures like accuracy, precision, recall, and cross-validation. A deep learning algorithm is also included to manage data on heart illness that is based on images. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) use the Lenet architecture for image classification, and pre-processing and data augmentation approaches improve model performance. In comparison to conventional approaches, this work suggests a sophisticated heart disease prediction model that combines Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) techniques, attaining an accuracy of X% and greatly lowering misclassification rates. By employing oversampling approaches, the suggested system effectively manages unbalanced datasets and enhances prediction robustness through feature selection and ensemble learning.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Application of Big Data and Machine Learning Algorithms in Electric Shock Prevention Warning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In view of the high incidence of electric shock accidents and the imperfect early warning system, big data analysis and machine learning algorithms are applied to precisely predict potential electric shock risks and give early warnings, thereby reducing the occurrence of electric shock accidents. First, various environmental, equipment, and personnel behavior data related to electric shock are collected and integrated, including indicators such as temperature and humidity, current fluctuations, and equipment usage frequency. Then, data preprocessing technology is used to clean the noise data to ensure data quality. Next, the support vector machine (SVM) machine learning algorithm is used to build a prediction model and train it through historical electric shock cases. Finally, the electric shock risk is predicted by inputting the model into the real-time monitoring data, and automatic warning is realized by combining the warning threshold. Studies have shown that the electric shock prevention warning system based on big data and machine learning has significantly improved in accuracy and response speed. Compared with traditional methods, the model can respond within 30 seconds after the electric shock event occurs, and the recall rate is close to 92%. The application of big data and machine learning algorithms in electric shock prevention warning has high practical value and potential. It not only improves the accuracy and real-time nature of warning, but also provides data support for preventive measures and reduces the risk of electric shock accidents.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Object Detection Model Based on Improved Convolutional Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning is the combination of reinforcement learning and deep learning. Reinforcement learning is used to define the problem itself and optimize the objective function, and deep learning is used to solve the problems such as state representation and policy expression. The advantage of attention mechanism is the ability to focus on the important parts of the input information. Object detection is an important branch of computer vision. The detection accuracy is constantly improving, but it is still far from meeting the requirements of human beings. One of the main reasons is that the model lacks the ability to express the target to be detected. In order to solve the problem of low detection accuracy and slow speed in deep reinforcement learning object detection model, this paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning object detection model based on improved convolutional attention mechanism. Through experiments, it is found that the model has better performance in the detection task.

articleTitle: Security Evaluation of Two-Dimensional Chaotic Function for Cryptographic Primitives Element
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 14th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Technologies in Industry 4.0 leverage various cryptographic systems to enhance the security of data and communication networks. Among these systems, primitive cryptographic methods, such as symmetric cryptography, play a crucial role. These include block ciphers, stream ciphers, hash functions, and pseudorandom number generators, all of which rely on core properties like randomness, confusion, and diffusion. In this context, chaos functions emerge as an effective solution for achieving these properties, as they are characterized by outputs that are both random and deterministic while being highly sensitive to input changes. A two-dimensional chaos function, in particular, can be constructed using a one-dimensional chaos function as its foundation, enabling broader and more continuous chaotic properties. This study develops algorithms for two-dimensional chaos functions to serve as building blocks for cryptographic primitives. The chaos functions explored include the Arnold Cat Map, Baker Map, Tinker Bell Map, Henon Map, Duffing Map, Zeraoulia-Sprott Map, Horshoe Map, and Linear Piecewise Map. These algorithms are evaluated based on their confusion and diffusion capabilities, and their randomness is assessed using the NIST SP800-22 Revision 1A test. The results indicate that the algorithm utilizing the Tinker Bell chaotic function demonstrates exceptional randomness, confusion, and diffusion properties, making it an ideal candidate for cryptographic primitives such as block ciphers, stream ciphers, hash functions, and pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs). The proposed Tinker Bell chaotic function, with its optimal parameter set, excels in terms of randomness and cryptographic strength, as demonstrated by the confusion, diffusion, and NIST SP800-22 test results. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm has a time complexity of O(n), where n represents the number of iterations of the chosen chaotic function. This ensures that the algorithm is both efficient and scalable, performing effectively even with larger inputs.
